org.allGoodBody: Once students and classes are added, this area will show things requiring attention.

invite.title: Invite to {org}
invite.noneBody: Invite a family, teacher or staff member to get started.
invite.createdNotEmailed: Invitation created for {email}, but no email went out - this installation has no email provider set up yet. Once one is configured you can resend it.
invite.createdSendFailed: Invitation created for {email}, but the email did not go out. You can resend it.
invite.resendHelp: Sends a new link and stops the old one from working.

portfolio.title: Your portfolio starts here.
portfolio.body: Save photos, worksheets, projects and learning activities throughout the year. Later, Homeschool OS will help organize them automatically.

documents.title: Keep important papers in one place.
documents.body: Upload letters, certificates, test results and anything else worth keeping. You'll be able to find them by child and by year.

calendar.title: Nothing scheduled yet.
calendar.body: Add lessons, activities, field trips and appointments so everyone knows what's happening.

learning.title: Plan what you're teaching.
learning.body: Build a simple plan by subject. You can start with a single week and grow it from there.

progress.title: Progress appears as you go.
progress.body: Once you've logged some work, you'll see how each subject is coming along. We won't show a score until there's enough to be meaningful.

messages.title: No messages yet.
messages.body: When you're connected with a teacher, tutor or program, your conversations will appear here.

records.title: Florida homeschool records
records.body: We'll help you organize important homeschool documents and dates. Nothing here is filed for you, and we'll never tell you that you're compliant.

reports.title: Reports are coming.
reports.body: When you have lessons, work and progress recorded, you'll be able to generate a clean summary for any date range.

orgStudents.title: No students yet.
orgStudents.body: Students join when a family enrolls, or you can add one directly.

orgFamilies.title: No families yet.
orgFamilies.body: Invite a family to connect their students to your program.

orgStaff.title: No staff yet.
orgStaff.body: Invite teachers and staff so they can take attendance, plan lessons and record progress.

orgClasses.title: No classes yet.
orgClasses.body: Create a class or pod, then add the students who attend it.

noChildren.title: Add a child first
noChildren.body: Everything you save belongs to one of your children, so start by adding one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageBody: Choose the language for your workspace.
settings.name: Name

kindHelp.document: A letter, a certificate, test results, anything worth keeping.

errors.saveFailed: That didn't save. Nothing was lost — try again.
errors.unknownKind: We don't know how to save that.
errors.uploadFailed: We couldn't upload your file. Check your connection and try again - nothing was lost.

upload.accepted: Photos and PDFs, up to 50 MB.
upload.duplicate: You've already saved this exact file.

errors.mismatch: This file isn't what its name says it is, so we didn't accept it.

smartIntake.title: Smart Intake is coming
smartIntake.body: Later, Homeschool OS will read what you upload and suggest a title, a subject and a date. It doesn't yet — nothing here has been analyzed, so what you type is what gets saved.

scan.pendingBody: Every upload is scanned before it can be opened. This usually takes a moment. Your file is saved.
scan.infectedTitle: This file isn't safe to open
scan.infectedBody: Our scan found something harmful in this file, so we won't open it. The record stays here, but the file itself will not be delivered to anyone.
scan.errorBody: Something went wrong while scanning. Until it's checked, we won't open it. Try uploading it again.
scan.skippedBody: No scanner is set up on this installation, so this file has not been checked and won't be opened.

visibility.label: Visible to
visibility.familyPrivateHelp: You and any guardian with full access. Nobody at a program can see it.
visibility.familySharedHelp: Every guardian on this family, including anyone with view-only access.
visibility.academicSharedHelp: Staff at your program who have academic access to this child.
visibility.assignedStaffHelp: Only the people specifically assigned to this child — not everyone on staff.
visibility.evaluatorSharedHelp: An evaluator who already holds an active grant for this child, for as long as it lasts.
visibility.organizationOperationalHelp: Program paperwork. Families see it only if it is shared with them.
visibility.systemComplianceHelp: Set by the compliance process, not chosen here.

deleteConfirm.body: It comes off the timeline. The photos and files stay saved, and this can be undone by asking support.

standards.relatedHelp: How this skill happens to line up with an outside framework. It is a reference, not a requirement.
standards.settingsBody: Some families like to see how a skill lines up with a state framework. Others never do. Either is fine, and this changes only what you see.

admin.title: Standards reference
admin.noAccess: Standards administration is a platform capability. Your account does not have it.

refresh.title: Revisit suggestions
refresh.help: When you turn this on, Nestra can point out a skill you might enjoy revisiting together. It never changes what your child has shown.
refresh.intervalHelp: A starting point, not a rule about children. Change it whenever you like.
refresh.suggestedBody: It may be useful to revisit this together. {name} is still secure in it — this is just a nudge, not a change.
refresh.noRecentEvidence: You haven't captured recent evidence for this skill.
refresh.dismissed: We won't bring this one up again for a while.
refresh.requested: Saved. We'll show this when you next look.
refresh.whyGoal: You have an active goal for this skill.
refresh.whyPlan: It's a priority in the current learning plan.
refresh.whyCourse: It's part of a course {name} is enrolled in.
refresh.whyPrerequisite: It underpins something {name} is working on now.
refresh.whyRequested: You asked to be reminded about this one.
refresh.offBody: Nothing is being tracked or judged. You can turn this on whenever it would be useful.

diagnostic.title: Explore together
diagnostic.intro: A few things to try, so Nestra can see what's useful. Nothing here is a test and nothing is scored.
diagnostic.nextFeelsRight: Nice — let's see what feels right next.
diagnostic.notThisTimeHelp: This tells us about this moment, not about your child.
diagnostic.pausedBody: Pick this up whenever suits you. Everything you've recorded is kept.
diagnostic.stoppedBody: Finished for now. What you recorded is kept.
diagnostic.exploreNext: These skills may be good places to explore next: {skills}.
diagnostic.notEnoughYet: We don't have enough evidence yet for {skills}.
diagnostic.whyExisting: You already have evidence here, so we didn't ask again.
diagnostic.whyNext: This follows on from something {name} has shown.
diagnostic.whyPrerequisite: This one underpins what we were exploring.
diagnostic.whyEnough: We saw enough to move on.
diagnostic.reviewBody: These are what we noticed. Keep the ones you agree with — nothing is added to {name}'s profile until you say so.

path.title: Suggested next steps
path.intro: Based on what Nestra currently knows, here is what could be worth exploring next. You can change this anytime.
path.empty: Nothing to suggest yet. As you capture what your child is doing, ideas will show up here.
path.newSuggestion: Nestra found something new that may change what makes sense next. Your plan can stay exactly as it is, or you can look at the update.
path.doneNote: Marking a step done records that you did it together. It is not a judgement about your child, and nothing about her profile changes.
path.noResource: We don't have material for this one yet. That's fine — the skill still belongs here.
path.horizonNote: A few steps at a time, on purpose. This answers what to explore next, not what a whole year looks like.

reason.parentGoal: You said this is what you want to work on
reason.activePlanPriority: It's one of the priorities in your active plan
reason.revisitRequested: You asked to come back to this
reason.diagnosticFrontier: This is around where your last exploring session ended
reason.uncertainBoundary: There's some evidence here and it doesn't settle the question yet
reason.continueConnectedSkill: It follows on from something you've already captured
reason.prerequisiteSupport: This usually comes first, and we don't have anything on it yet
reason.curriculumResourceAvailable: You already have material for this one
reason.enrichment: Something to do with a skill you've confirmed

readiness.prerequisitesCharacterized: What this builds on has useful evidence
readiness.prerequisiteUncertain: One thing it builds on is still an open question
readiness.prerequisiteNotCharacterized: We don't have evidence yet for something this builds on
readiness.noPrerequisitesInGraph: Nothing is known to come before this
readiness.noEvidenceYet: We don't have enough evidence yet
readiness.uncertaintyAtThisBoundary: The evidence here doesn't settle it
readiness.diagnosticStoppedNearHere: The last exploring session ended around here

warning.prerequisiteUsuallyComesFirst: {skill} usually comes before this. You can still put it here, or include {skill} first.
warning.noResourceAvailableYet: We don't have material for this one yet.
warning.alreadyConfirmedByAPerson: You've already confirmed this one. Would you like to include it anyway?

activity.title: Activities
activity.intro: Ways to actually do the next step. An activity is one way in — the skill matters, the worksheet doesn't.
activity.noneNote: There's nothing in your library for this one yet. That's fine — the skill still belongs here, and you can add something of your own.
activity.addYourOwnNote: Anything counts: measuring cups in the kitchen, a walk, a conversation. Describe what you're going to do together.
activity.replaceNote: Same skill, different way in. Nothing about the first one was wrong, and nothing about your child changes.
activity.replacedEarlier: You swapped this one out earlier
activity.doneNote: Marking an activity done records that you did it. It is not a judgement about your child, and nothing about her profile changes.
activity.notTodayNote: Not today, and that's all it means. Nothing is counted against anyone.
activity.skipNote: Set aside. Days go differently than planned, and Nestra doesn't keep score.
activity.goalTargetNote: This is what you're working toward rather than this week's step. You can still choose an activity for it yourself.
activity.secureNote: You've already confirmed this one. Nestra won't suggest going back over it on its own — ask to revisit it whenever you'd like.
activity.alreadyChosen: You've already chosen something for this step.
activity.demoResource: A Nestra demonstration resource — not curriculum, and not a provider's material
activity.waitingForReview: {count} possible matches are waiting for someone to review them

modality.label: Kind of activity
modality.note: This describes the activity, not your child. Nestra doesn't decide what kind of learner anyone is.

availability.requiresSubscription: This needs a subscription you don't have right now
availability.note: Whether something opens today says nothing about whether it's the right thing.

reason.confirmedSkillMatch: Someone confirmed this material covers this skill
reason.activeCurriculum: It's from curriculum you're already using
reason.parentProviderPreference: It's from a provider you prefer
reason.modalityMatch: You asked for this kind of activity
reason.languageMatch: It's in the language you asked for
reason.deterministicTiebreak: Several would have worked; this one came first in a fixed order

noResourceReason.noEligibleConfirmedResource: Nothing in your library has been confirmed to cover this skill yet
noResourceReason.blockedByInactiveHome: {count} in a course that's no longer active
